signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Freight Trains are relentless runners who refuse to go down on first contact. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their chance to break the next tackle.
Running Backs with this ability receive improved blocking from their O-Line within 5 yards of the end zone
Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at high speeds.
Ballcarriers with this ability will frequently attempt to gain extra yards while being tackled
Locker room pep talks go a long way. Players with this ability can easily enter the Zone in the 2nd half.
Defenders with this ability generally react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage
Defenders with this ability are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves (and cannot be faked out when user-controlled).
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
The most tenacious defenders beat their blocks by sheer force of will. When they enter the zone, their rush move attempts are free.
Defenders with this ability are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves (and cannot be faked out when user-controlled).
Defenders with this ability can reach out of engaged blocks to tackle or sack nearby ballcarriers.
Defenders with this ability can apply pressure to the quarterback from a greater distance.
The best physical receivers don't just come down with the ball, they carry it home. When they enter the zone, they are nearly guaranteed to break their first post-catch tackle.
Players with this ability will recover from the effects of fatigue at an increased rate between plays.
Receivers with this ability make sharper cuts and frequently win contested catches when covered by linebackers and linemen.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers
Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt and win pull blocks
Blockers with this ability start every new blocking encounter with built-in resistance
During preplay, players with this ability will highlight any oncoming blitzers on 3rd and 4th downs. Can be bluffed.
Kickers with this ability experience a slower kicking meter for better power and accuracy on kicks up to 45 yards.
Passers with this ability have faster passing animations when they are throwing under pressure
Passers with this ability improve the catching prowess of all running backs who are open on pass plays.
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against outside zone plays.
Defenders with this ability can make jumping, 180-degree interceptions while lurking in a zone in the middle of the field.
Defenders with this ability are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves (and cannot be faked out when user-controlled).
